title: Not Just a Subject: Capturing Adaptive Scene-Specific Variance for Visual Storytelling
title_zh: 不仅仅是主题：捕捉视觉叙事中适应特定场景的变异性

paragraphs.en: EOS-Story 是一个无需训练的框架，能够在文本与视觉空间中协调身份一致性以及对特定场景的适应性。 Recent advancements in diffusion models have significantly improved text-to-image generation, enabling their application to visual storytelling, where coherent image sequences are generated from narrative prompts. However, existing methods primarily focus on identity preservation and often fail to adapt to diverse scene variations, resulting in semantic misalignment and structural inflexibility. We propose EOS-Story, a training-free framework that harmonizes identity consistency with scene-specific adaptation across text and vision spaces. In the text space, we decouple the narrative into identity and scene sub-prompts to prevent information dilution, but this leaves the scene without access to appearance cues. To bridge this gap, we introduce Cross-Contextual Bridging, which softly injects a phrase-level appearance residual into the scene's embedding. In the vision space, we find that scale mismatch between identity and scene subjects causes a few identity tokens to be repeatedly transferred, producing structural artifacts. We address this with Adaptive Identity Preservation, which anchors identity features at the scene-specific scale (Identity Anchoring) and integrates them via Identity-Aware Self-Attention. To evaluate performance under varied spatial compositions, we extend the Consistory+ benchmark with diverse framing scenarios (Consistory+_+). Extensive experiments show that EOS-Story achieves competitive or superior performance on both benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: EOS-Story 是一个无需训练的框架，能够在文本与视觉空间中协调身份一致性以及对特定场景的适应性。扩散模型的最新进展显著提升了文本到图像生成能力，使其能够应用于视觉叙事，即从叙事提示生成连贯的图像序列。 然而，现有方法主要关注身份保持，往往无法适应多样的场景变化，导致语义错位和结构僵化。 我们提出 EOS-Story，这是一个无需训练的框架，能够在文本与视觉空间中协调身份一致性与针对特定场景的适应性。 在文本空间中，我们将叙事解耦为身份子提示和场景子提示以防止信息稀释，但这使得场景无法获取外观线索。 为了弥合这一差距，我们引入跨上下文桥接，将短语级的外观残差柔和地注入场景的嵌入中。 在视觉空间中，我们发现身份主体与场景主体之间的尺度失配会导致少数身份 token 被反复转移，从而产生结构性伪影。 我们通过自适应身份保持来解决这一问题，该机制在特定场景的尺度上锚定身份特征（身份锚定），并通过身份感知自注意力对其进行整合。 为了评估在不同空间构图下的性能，我们通过多样的取景场景扩展了 Consistory+ 基准（Consistory+_+）。 大量实验表明，EOS-Story 在两个基准上均取得了具有竞争力或更优的性能。
